evidence_items.claim: Yoji Imafuku (Chief Strategy Officer, Mizuho EMEA) serves on ISDA Board, continuing term elected 2025
evidence_items.excerpt: Yoji Imafuku, Managing Director, Head of Derivatives Business Planning, Mizuho Securities Co., Ltd., joined the ISDA Board.

evidence_items.claim: Mizuho is NOT a FINOS member - not listed on FINOS members page
evidence_items.excerpt: Mizuho, Mizuho Financial Group, and its subsidiaries are not listed as FINOS members.

evidence_items.claim: Mizuho participant in ISDA Future Leaders in Derivatives program (2024 AI whitepaper)
evidence_items.excerpt: Takuya Otani, Director, Counterparty Portfolio Management Desk at Mizuho, participated in ISDA Future Leaders in Derivatives program.

evidence_items.claim: Mizuho sponsored ISDA event on future of asset management in Japan (2024)
evidence_items.excerpt: ISDA held an event exploring policy initiatives for asset management in Japan, with Mizuho, MUFG and Nomura as sponsors.

evidence_items.claim: Mizuho is a shareholder in Progmat digital securities platform (~6.5% stake)
evidence_items.excerpt: Other shareholders were diluted, including three other banks—SMBC, Mizuho, and Sumitomo Mitsui Trust—which each previously held 7.5% and now own just under 6.5%.

null_results.actual_result: Mizuho is NOT a FINOS member. No CDM contribution found.
No evidence of CDM production deployment.
No evidence despite ISDA Board presence and Future Leaders participation.
